actions: launch the 09.9 divergence kernel (tst_divergenceReconvergence) with GRID_X=1, BLOCK_X=8
caption: Divergent warp: odd lanes grey (masked), even lanes green, [+1 path]
source:
# 09.9 Experiment A: the divergence kernel (tst_divergenceReconvergence),
# launched with GRID_X = 1, BLOCK_X = 8. Set the GPU parameter SMs to 1.
.data
arr:    .zero 32
kernel:
    .word 0x01040000    #  0: S_TID R1
    .word 0x06884001    #  1: ANDI R2, R1, 1
    .word 0x08408400    #  2: SETP.NE P0, R2, 0
    .word 0x80c00006    #  3: @P0 BRA 6 (odd)
    .word 0x060c0064    #  4: MOV R3, 100
    .word 0x00c00007    #  5: BRA 7 (join)
    .word 0x060c00c8    #  6: odd: MOV R3, 200
    .word 0x01100004    #  7: join: S_ARG R4, 0
    .word 0x07544002    #  8: SHL R5, R1, 2
    .word 0x02111400    #  9: ADD R4, R4, R5
    .word 0x0a4d0000    # 10: STG [R4], R3
    .word 0x00400000    # 11: EXIT
.text
main:
    li   s0, GPU_0_BASE
    la   t0, kernel
    sw   t0, GPU_0_KERNEL_PC_OFFSET(s0)
    li   t0, 1
    sw   t0, GPU_0_GRID_X_OFFSET(s0)
    li   t0, 8
    sw   t0, GPU_0_BLOCK_X_OFFSET(s0)
    la   t0, arr
    sw   t0, GPU_0_ARG0_OFFSET(s0)
    li   t0, GPU_0_CTRL_START
    sw   t0, GPU_0_CTRL_OFFSET(s0)
    li   t1, GPU_0_STATUS_DONE
wait:
    lw   t0, GPU_0_STATUS_OFFSET(s0)
    and  t0, t0, t1
    beqz t0, wait
    sw   t1, GPU_0_STATUS_OFFSET(s0)
    li   a7, 10
    ecall
shot_note: Peripheral widget only. Host program in "source" launches the divergence kernel with GRID_X=1, BLOCK_X=8, SMs=1. The row suffix reads "diverged: 2 paths" (not "[+1 path]").
